components.name: Sunk Input
components.description: Text field cut into the paper.

components.name: Raised Panel
components.description: Panel that sits above the sheet; its contents stay flush or sunk.

narrative.overview: One sheet of pale celadon security paper, pressed rather than printed. Relief is the state language: raised means pressable, sunk means it holds a value or is selected, flush means disabled.
keyCharacteristics: Single light celadon ground; no borders anywhere.
Five relief steps and no other shadows.
Five fixed role inks; each colour means one thing everywhere.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: A role ink is never borrowed for decoration.

rules.name: The Five-Step Rule
rules.body: No shadow exists outside the five-step list.

rules.name: The No-Stack Rule
rules.body: A raised panel never sits on a raised panel.

dos: Do let relief carry state: raised to press, sunk for a value or the selected item, flush for disabled.
donts: Don't add a visible border; use an engraved groove or a relief step.
